lines.say: How often should you train each muscle?
The classic bro split hits each muscle once a week. Chest Monday, legs Thursday.
An early review found training each muscle twice a week grew more than once.
But a later review looked closer. When the total number of weekly sets was the same, how you split them barely mattered.
So the weekly sets matter most. Frequency is how you spread them out.
Splitting them over two or three days often helps, because every set stays fresh and strong.
Pick the split you'll actually stick to.
